summary.name: Iridescent Materials, Digital and 3D Aesthetics; normalized from pearlescent silk and molten glass descriptions.
summary.visualIdentity: One dominant pearlescent, silk or molten-glass surface with coherent highlights and controlled color shifts on a quiet background. Reveal through measured flow, folds or macro framing, not rainbow noise.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: macro material studies, product finish reveals, and beauty or fashion campaigns in editorial layouts. Inferred: quiet hero loops and product pages with one dominant finish.
summary.limitations: Avoid rainbow shaders, blown highlights, chrome type and quick cuts. Basic XPBD gives silk deformation only, not iridescence or molten glass. Two-color contrast checks do not verify text over video or animated light.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent, chosen from subject and mood, not a fixed beige. Example tokens (#F1EDEA, #3F4351, #A99DC1, #9FB9B2, #D3ADA1) are unapproved; task-exact colors override them. Foreground on background is 8.458:1; accent_1 is decorative only.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Reveal through measured flow, folds, rotation or macro framing via keyframes or cached simulation. Motion-043 fits one stationary object under fixed lights, with capped highlights and no flow during the orbit. Interactive pointer or scroll motion is optional.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified and not mandatory. Inferred: silence or soft ambience suits material studies, with at most one restrained accent at a key reveal. Do not claim beat or speech sync without measured data.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required. Renders need Blender with Cycles or bpy. Supplied exact colors and assets override defaults. Orbit motion needs complete 3D geometry; flat art supports only a labelled partial-arc adaptation.
summary.combinations: style-020: serif headlines in #3F4351 on #F1EDEA, with color only from the material. style-096: one move per shot, avoiding rainbow shaders and quick cuts.
summary.productionApproach: Blender with Cycles and bpy serve as style_renderer and motion_engine. HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion is fallback only with a recorded reason. GSAP owns the paused timeline; chroma-js and XPBD (silk only) are optional.
